name: Howest University of Applied Sciences
summary: University of applied sciences in Kortrijk and Bruges; five English-taught bachelor's, from games and AI to cybersecurity and product design.

ib.text: A diploma giving access to university at home, B2 English and a motivation letter. The IB counts for English if taught in English, or with English A/B HL at 5 or English B SL at 6. €50 fee.

programmes.name: Creative Technologies and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: The full AI pipeline, from collecting data and training models to deploying them, taught project by project; from year 2 you specialise in AI-driven robotics or as an AI developer, with projects for real clients.
programmes.ib: No subject requirements published beyond the general rule: an access diploma, B2 English and a motivation letter.
programmes.selectionNote: No entrance test or ranking: a qualifying diploma, B2 English and a motivation letter admit you. Howest may close a programme once one country hits its limit.

programmes.name: Cybersecurity
programmes.about: Attack-and-defence training: you learn to think like a hacker and use their tools to secure networks, cloud and industrial systems, with an internship at home or abroad. Taught entirely in English in Bruges.
programmes.ib: Howest expects at least four hours of maths a week at school; prior computing knowledge is useful but not needed.
programmes.selectionNote: No entrance test or ranking: a qualifying diploma, B2 English and a motivation letter admit you. Howest may close a programme once one country hits its limit.

programmes.name: Digital Arts and Entertainment
programmes.about: Content for games and film taught as a technical artist: mostly hands-on practice, a three-day game jam and an 18-week internship. You choose one of six majors, from game development to VFX.
programmes.ib: Choose a major at the start: game development, independent game production, game graphics, game sound, 3D animation or VFX. No portfolio needed.
programmes.selectionNote: No portfolio or test: a qualifying diploma, B2 English and a motivation letter admit you; the page states no limit on enrolments.

programmes.name: Digital Design and Development (DEVINE)
programmes.about: Visual design, creative coding and experience design for websites, apps and installations, in a Design-UX or a Technology track, with studio projects for real briefs and an internship. Also taught in Dutch.
programmes.ib: No portfolio or subject requirements published: an access diploma, B2 English and a motivation letter.
programmes.selectionNote: No entrance test or ranking: a qualifying diploma, B2 English and a motivation letter admit you. Howest may close a programme once one country hits its limit.

programmes.name: Industrial Product Design
programmes.about: The whole product design process, from concept and CAD to a production-ready prototype, about two-thirds of it in studios and workshops (wood, metal, 3D printing, laser cutting), with an optional interior-product track.
programmes.ib: No portfolio or subject requirements published: an access diploma, B2 English and a motivation letter.
programmes.selectionNote: No entrance test or ranking: a qualifying diploma, B2 English and a motivation letter admit you. Howest may close a programme once one country hits its limit.

notes: Applications for an autumn start open on 1 January; for 2026-27 the EEA deadline was 1 July, and 2027 dates are not yet published.
Howest may stop taking applications for some programmes once a limit from one country is reached, so it advises applying early.
Degree students can start only in September, not in the spring semester.
